known_unrelated_delta.reason: P2E16 calls the reference_richards_legacy_solver_t and RossFast soil-water solver directly behind the common soil-water solver request; the serialized application backend is not linked into the scientific comparison.

purpose: Prospectively probe the exact state-local RossFast prescribed-flux forcing boundary from both sides on both top and bottom faces, while retaining the P2E14 candidate-independent discrepancy thresholds and separating Reference threshold-transfer validity from RossFast route admission.
scientific_question: Does the predeclared RossFast production forcing contract produce a reproducible inside/boundary/outside admission surface across all 36 materials and three independently selected common-state anchors, and do route-valid boundary cases remain scientifically admissible under the unchanged candidate-independent P2E14 discrepancy thresholds where those thresholds remain Reference-valid?

matrix.materials: all 36 D3R materials B01-B18 and O01-O18
matrix.state_anchor_source: P2E13 prospectively selected complete 36-material common Reference domain
matrix.rho_definition: signed distance from the state-local reference flux divided by the exact production envelope limit; |rho|<1 is inside, |rho|=1 is exact inclusive boundary, |rho|>1 is outside

boundary_construction.reason_for_rho_design: The production envelope uses a state-local max(...,1e-12) scale. Defining cases by rho probes the actual contract boundary for every material/state instead of assuming that a fixed flux/K factor is equivalent in all states.

stage_A_reference_only_threshold_transfe.purpose: Before new boundary RossFast discrepancy is inspected, test whether the immutable P2E14 Se-stratified threshold remains at least as large as Reference temporal self-disagreement for each new boundary forcing request.

thresholds.transfer_rule: REFERENCE_THRESHOLD_TRANSFER_VALID only if all five U metrics are <= the exact-Se P2E14 threshold and all Reference route-validity gates pass.

stage_A_reference_only_threshold_transfe.negative_policy: A Reference threshold-transfer failure is retained as a scientific boundary result. No threshold is widened. The corresponding P2E16B case may still test RossFast route fail-closed semantics, but no pairwise scientific-discrepancy admission claim is authorized for that case.

stage_B_candidate_boundary_primary.authorization: Only after Stage A result is persisted unchanged.

primary_endpoints.route_boundary: Observed RossFast route admission/rejection versus the preregistered |rho| class on every attempted case.
primary_endpoints.inside_boundary_scientific_admissibility: For Stage-A-transfer-valid cases with |rho|<=1 and both routes valid, all five Reference-versus-RossFast discrepancies must be <= the unchanged exact-Se P2E14 thresholds.
primary_endpoints.outside_fail_closed: For |rho|=1.05 cases whose Reference fixed-step request is valid, RossFast must reject before publishing a converged candidate and must not fall back.

hypotheses.P2E16_H1: The exact production forcing envelope predicts RossFast route validity across material and common-state axes: |rho|<1 and |rho|=1 are admitted, |rho|>1 is rejected.
hypotheses.P2E16_H2: Where the unchanged P2E14 threshold remains Reference-valid under the new boundary forcing, route-valid |rho|<=1 cases remain scientifically admissible without threshold widening.
hypotheses.P2E16_H3: Just-outside |rho|=1.05 requests fail closed with no silent Reference fallback or accepted candidate publication while the matched Reference request remains valid.

falsification_and_narrowing.H1: Any reproducible mismatch between preregistered rho class and RossFast route admission narrows or falsifies the claimed forcing-domain description; no case may be deleted.
falsification_and_narrowing.H2: Any valid pairwise discrepancy failure narrows the scientific substitution domain. Reference-threshold-transfer failures are not attributed to RossFast and instead narrow the threshold-transfer domain.
falsification_and_narrowing.H3: Any just-outside RossFast admission, silent fallback, or authoritative candidate publication falsifies the fail-closed boundary claim for that case.

next_permitted_action: Implement Stage A Reference-only 1296-case threshold-transfer harness exactly as frozen. Do not execute any new P2E16 RossFast candidate case until the Stage A result is persisted.
